messages:
natalie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we spotted a recurring partial-response + timeout pattern on the streaming/chat endpoint. Need clear owners + short ETAs for fixes this sprint. Main candidates: 1) reconnect/backoff behavior, 2) server chunk buffering and acking, 3) timeout thresholds + better observability events. Please claim items and add ticket IDs.

sam: I can take reconnect/backoff for the client SDK and proxy layer. Plan: uniform exponential backoff + jitter, cap inflight reconnects. ETA by Wed EOD. Creating ticket RDW-6198 now.

omar: I'll pick up server chunk buffering/acking. Hypothesis: under bursty loads we hit the per-connection chunk queue limit and drop trailing chunks -> partial responses. Need to confirm metrics. Will add a small synthetic against staging to reproduce. ETA Fri. Ticket RDW-6201.

tasha: I'll own the timeout tuning + observability: add structured events when a stream sees >1 partial chunk gap, emit histogram of chunk inter-arrival. Can we add a tiny span to trace chunkassembly? ETA Thu morning. Ticket RDW-6199.

mike: Noted. I'll help with the staging harness and run load profiles to validate omar's changes. Can we get a short checklist of configs to toggle?

omar: Adding a quick config snippet to toggle in staging:

```
streaming: 
  max_chunk_queue: 12
  chunk_ack_timeout_ms: 4500
  allow_out_of_order_acks: false
```

I'll try +/- values during testing.

sam: For reconnect strategy I'm proposing this pseudo-config (client + proxy):

```
reconnect: 
  base_ms: 200
  max_ms: 60000
  jitter: full
  max_attempts: 8
  allow_parallel_handshake: false
```

This should reduce flapping and duplicate inflight requests.

tasha: Also propose a short-term mitigation: if we detect >10% partial responses over 5m for a deployment, route new requests to a lower-util pool and incrementally rollout the client backoff. Could be automated as a follow-up. Thoughts?

natalie: 👍 good. Let's not automate too fast — do manual rollovers for one week to observe. Sam/omar/tasha, please update tickets with exact test plans. We'll track in this thread and in the weekly reliability sync.

sam: RDW-6198 updated with test plan and expected metrics (reduction in duplicate handshakes, lower reconnect rate). Will post load graphs when done. :white_check_mark:

omar: RDW-6201 updated; reproduced in staging with 20k concurrent streams at burst. Found queue saturation at default=8. Increasing to 12 improved tail but not eliminated gap. Next: try chunk pacing and ack batching.

tasha: RDW-6199 updated with proposed histogram + span. Also added alert rule draft: "stream.partial_gap_rate > 0.05 for 5m" -> P2.

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-14-stream-partial-gap. Linked tickets: RDW-6198, RDW-6199, RDW-6201.

natalie: Good. Two more items: 1) weekly owner rotation for any recurring stream incidents (1hr sync, Tue 10am), 2) a short doc (1 pager) on how to interpret chunk-level traces for oncall. Who can draft?

mike: I can draft the one-pager. Will share by Mon noon.

sam: I'll be on the Tue 10am sync for the next two weeks to shepherd rollouts.

omar: After changes land in staging, I'll tag the release and coordinate a limited canary (5% traffic) before full rollout.

tasha: I'll add the canary observability dashboard panel and a quick playbook blurb for SRE to follow if alerts fire.

natalie: Thanks all. Please comment here the exact ETA date (not just day) once you have it. We'll close this follow-up when all three tickets have code merged, canaryed, and verified in prod.

sam: ETA Wed 2026-03-18 23:59 UTC for client/backoff PR.

omar: ETA Fri 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC for server buffering PR (staging validated).

tasha: ETA Thu 2026-03-19 12:00 UTC for observability + alerts.

mike: One-pager draft shared at RDW-6210.

natalie: Awesome. I'll run the first Tue sync on 2026-03-24 10:00 and send calendar invite to #eng-sre and #eng-runtime. We'll reconvene here after canary verification. :sparkles:
